scope: Local throwaway ClickHouse and owned local test listeners only; no live deployment
preflight_cases: Missing or unsafe private address rejected before execution
Loopback defaults and independent overrides forwarded
Noninteger, privileged, out-of-range, health, metrics and duplicate ports rejected
Occupied loopback gRPC and HTTP ports rejected before execution
Wildcard listener rejected as a loopback conflict
Different concrete interface listener does not block loopback
Free loopback ports allow command execution
limitations: Five-second integration smoke only; the earlier ten-minute byte-queue proof was not repeated for the port-only change
Both receiver HTTP endpoints were exercised on separate local addresses and independent ports, not a real tailnet interface
Native macOS lsof, launchd deployment and gRPC sends remain operator checks
Port inspection cannot reserve a port against startup races
